Step 4: the resolving change is source code in the consumer (switch to ros::MessageEvent), not a build-system or dependency change; rebuilding the consumer because the provider's declaration changed is an interface change per the rule. Step 5: not firmware. Step 6: eligible, interface kind library API (a generated-class member declaration).

The ROBUST record asserts the stage and tooling without showing output: 'References to a non-existing field in C++ cause a build failure (reported by type and name analysis).' and 'detected-by: compiler' (https://github.com/robust-rosin/robust/blob/master/geometry2/932c6ca/932c6ca.bug); a removed class member would be a compiler error at build, but that observation is not in the source.

resolution.summary: Commit 932c6ca (PR #51): TransformListener's subscription callbacks take 'const ros::MessageEvent<tf2_msgs::TFMessage>& msg_evt' instead of 'const tf2_msgs::TFMessageConstPtr& msg', read the message with 'msg_evt.getConstMessage()' and obtain the authority with 'std::string authority = msg_evt.getPublisherName(); // lookup the authority', removing every use of msg_in.__connection_header.
resolution.evidence: Diff of 932c6ca: '-    std::map<std::string, std::string>* msg_header_map = msg_in.__connection_header.get();' ... '+  const tf2_msgs::TFMessage& msg_in = *(msg_evt.getConstMessage());' / '+  std::string authority = msg_evt.getPublisherName(); // lookup the authority' (https://github.com/ros/geometry2/commit/932c6cafd2b7959133fb32303e8c27cca3ff9e33); tfoote: 'Merged into indigo-devel' (https://github.com/ros/geometry2/pull/51#issuecomment-35126925). The resolved consumer was released as 0.5.0 with the indigo line, but no build or run of it against gencpp 0.5.0 is shown in the source.

notes: consumer_built_against is inferred from declarations: the consumer's reference to __connection_header matches the member declared in gencpp's msg.h.template through 0.4.16 ('boost::shared_ptr<std::map<std::string, std::string> > __connection_header;') and absent from 0.5.0; the resolved consumer references only members present in 0.5.0. Because it is inferred, every other change between gencpp 0.4.16 and 0.5.0 is also visible to the checkers. The provider unit is gencpp rather than tf2_msgs because the member is emitted by gencpp's template into every generated message header (tf2_msgs/TFMessage.h is generated at build time from tf2_msgs's unchanged .msg file); the same removal affected other consumers named in gencpp issue #3 (topic_tools, actionlib, tutorials), which are other compositions. The resolved composition additionally relies on roscpp's ros::MessageEvent API (getConstMessage, getPublisherName), a third unit not part of the failing composition. Python messages keep their _connection_header attribute (kwatts: 'I don't see any reason to deprecate or remove it in Python'), so tf2_ros's python listener is unaffected. The ROBUST record's 'pull-request: https://github.com/ros/geometry2/pull/51' is marked not merged on GitHub (merged_at null, 'STATE: closed') while the commit was merged into indigo-devel, matching the packet note.
